product: ISCCP H-series Basic HGM (Gridded Monthly Mean) - cldamt 'Mean cloud amount' (NOAA NCEI Climate Data Record)
licence_credit: file attribute license: 'No constraints on data access or use.'; cite Rossow and Schiffer 1999 BAMS 80:2261-2287 doi:10.1175/1520-0477(1999)080<2261:AIUCFI>2.0.CO;2 and the NCEI ISCCP-H CDR
native_resolution: 1 degree equal-angle (EA1) - identical to our cells
aggregation_to_cell: native grid is our grid (centres -89.5..89.5, 0.5..359.5): rows flipped to north-first and longitudes rolled by 180 so col 0 = -179.5; per cell, arithmetic mean of the monthly means over 2012-2016, cell kept only with >= 48 of 60 valid months (no area weighting needed: one native cell = one table cell); no polar-night treatment needed (cldamt is a day+night IR-based amount)
caveats: satellite cloud detection is least reliable over snow/ice and polar night; 22 of 64,800 cells empty; coastal 1-degree cells mix land and ocean clouds; cloud amount is not irradiance (aerosol and cloud optical depth ignored)

product: count of valid monthly cldamt values
